svg.title: Tracking Monkey Typing: commits, lines, and tokens
svg.desc: Tracking Monkey Typing shows aggregate weekly commits and line movement, followed by combined lifetime tokens on the same date domain when history is available. Code movement, last five years at weekly grain. Totals: 3,335 commits, 33,791,136 additions, 31,968,307 deletions, and 160 active weeks. The commit axis uses log1p; the signed additions and deletions axis uses symmetric log. Rounded combined Codex lifetime: 52.8B tokens, observed Jul 27, 2026. 10 anonymous daily last observations from Jul 16, 2026 through Jul 27, 2026. Dates before tracking began are unobserved, not zero. The token axis is linear from zero and shares the GitHub five-year date domain. Multi-day observation gaps are dashed. Values are combined before publication; per-source readings and identities are not published. Provenance: automatic refresh. The approximate conversion is ~$42.0K using this site's current blended public API replay rate of 0.796269 dollars per million tokens as of 2026-07-12; it is not an actual bill.
svg.text: Five years of code movement and observed combined lifetime-token history
